tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations establish the predicted endogenous reversal and cover the target horizon. Fit the archived dual-horizon law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The measured response changes from positive to negative at longer horizons, inconsistent with these monotone positive-gain mechanisms.
The long-horizon probe supplies three discriminating observations, giving eight rows for the four-parameter dual-exponential model; an additional batch is not currently needed.
All observed sink gradients are zero, so its sink dependence is not identifiable from these observations.
